authored.name: Ranged Weapon Mastery
authored._note: AE was already on the actor copy with `attack_accuracy_mod_ranged += SL` (priority 1) — MORE specific than my intended bonus_accuracy_check key (only boosts ranged accuracy, not melee). Verified working at item.level=4. No change needed.

authored.name: Grace Under Pressure
authored._note: Embedded AE created with `bonus_defense += ${level}$` (mode 2, priority 20, transfer true). At item.level=2 → +2 DEF applied. Blanche.bonus_defense observed = 9 (includes 2 from GUP + 7 other sources); blanche.defense = 21. NOTE: RAW gates this on Crisis. Crisis-only gating not enforced engine-side (aeStatusWhen('crisis') for bonus_defense is not wired). Ship as always-on bonus with player-honour Crisis gate; surface as a follow-up gap. Player toggles AE off manually when not in Crisis.

authored.name: Perfect Aim
authored._note: Composition skill — when Warning Shot fires, may choose two options instead of one. No mechanical automation; resolves at the table when Warning Shot pipeline lands. BD master created for picker/encyclopedia visibility.

authored.name: Deep Pockets
authored._note: IP-cost discount (minimum 1). No per-cost discount engine yet — costs are static at present. Surface as future work: add a cost-modifier hook in the cost-substitution pipeline (parallel to `substitute_cost` effect_kind).

authored.name: Status Immunity
authored._note: Player picks one status (Blanche picked Paralyzed). Engine gap: no per-actor status-immunity flag on the actor data model. Future work: add `status_immunity_<status>` boolean props + gate apply_ae at write time.

authored.name: Elegance Showmanship
authored._note: Doubles the bonus from Grace Under Pressure (so +SL*2 DEF in Crisis) AND adds +1 to every Adoration Clock fill. Adoration Clock is a Matador custom resource pool — not wired. Resolve at the table for now.

deferred_with_gap.name: Hawkeye
deferred_with_gap.raw: When you perform the Guard action, if you choose not to provide cover to another creature, you may choose one option: (a) next ranged attack deals SL*2 extra damage; (b) free attack with bow/firearm, HR=0.
deferred_with_gap.gap: Needs `creature_guards` trigger. Two effect_kinds needed: queued-damage-bonus (carry SL*2 to next ranged attack's COMPUTE) and free_action with HR=0 attack mode.
deferred_with_gap.ship_when: Phase F + new trigger + queued-bonus effect_kind.

deferred_with_gap.name: Warning Shot
deferred_with_gap.raw: When you hit one or more targets with a ranged attack that would deal damage, you may have the attack deal no damage. If you do, choose one option: Shaken / Slow / target loses SL*10 MP per hit.
deferred_with_gap.gap: Hit-conversion: replace damage commit with status apply or MP debit. Needs `replace_damage` effect_kind or a `mode: 'shape-only'` hit option. Pairs with Perfect Aim (pick 2 options instead of 1).

deferred_with_gap.name: Barrage
deferred_with_gap.raw: Ranged attack + 10 MP → gain Multi 2, or +1 Multi up to Multi 3.
deferred_with_gap.gap: Multi-property modifier on weapon mid-attack. Needs weapon-property mutation effect_kind.

deferred_with_gap.name: Crossfire
deferred_with_gap.raw: When a creature you can see performs a ranged attack against an ally, you may spend MP = the result of their Accuracy Check and intercept...
deferred_with_gap.gap: Needs `creature_attempts_attack` trigger with isRanged subject filter + variable-MP cost = check result.

deferred_with_gap.name: Fancy Footwork
deferred_with_gap.raw: When an enemy attacks you and misses, if their Accuracy is at least 6-SL lower than your Defense, they suffer Fatigue.
deferred_with_gap.gap: Needs `creature_attack_missed` trigger with miss-margin payload field. Bonus has a condition gate (margin >= 6-SL).
deferred_with_gap.ship_when: Phase F + new trigger + margin field.

deferred_with_gap.name: Counter Pass
deferred_with_gap.raw: Once per round, when an enemy attacks you and misses, may perform a Pass Skill as a reaction (must target the missed attacker).
deferred_with_gap.gap: Needs `creature_attack_missed` trigger + free-action pipeline restricted to Pass-type skills + target_lock to the missed attacker.
deferred_with_gap.ship_when: Phase F + new trigger + free-action filter extension (already 90% there — open_action_menu's allowed_types filter exists for the Painful Lesson pattern).

deferred_with_gap.name: Thread the Horns
deferred_with_gap.raw: When a creature targets you for a melee attack and misses, may spend 10 MP to inflict Provoked until end of their next action.
deferred_with_gap.gap: Needs `creature_attack_missed` trigger with melee subject filter + duration AE keyed to attacker's next action.
deferred_with_gap.ship_when: Phase F + new trigger + action-keyed duration.

deferred_with_gap.name: Shadow Strike
deferred_with_gap.raw: Roll Might die, lose HP equal to result, perform free attack dealing SL + die_result extra damage. Damage type becomes dark.
deferred_with_gap.gap: Needs `roll_die` effect_kind that emits a numeric value into ctx for downstream consume_resource (HP cost = MIGHT_DIE) + add_damage (bonus = SL + MIGHT_DIE) + damage-element override (dark, attack scope).
deferred_with_gap.ship_when: Phase B.2 — new effect_kind `roll_die` + threaded result formula identifier MIGHT_DIE_ROLLED.

deferred_with_gap.name: Emergency Item
deferred_with_gap.raw: Once per conflict scene, while in Crisis, perform an additional Inventory action on your turn.
deferred_with_gap.gap: Needs Crisis-gated extra-action-slot mechanic. Action economy modifier — current FSM doesn't support extra slots mid-turn.

deferred_with_gap.name: Upgrade
deferred_with_gap.raw: Once per rest, modify a weapon/armor/shield with a Quality from the table.
deferred_with_gap.gap: Out-of-combat rest-time item modification + Quality system (catalogue of named buffs).
deferred_with_gap.ship_when: Phase I (rest pipeline) + new Quality registry.

deferred_with_gap.name: Gadgets
deferred_with_gap.gap: Massive scope — Alchemy (roll-dice-and-branch potion creation), Infusions (damage-type swap on hit), Magitech (Magicannon / Magisphere / Construct summons).

engine_gaps_surfaced._design: Fire after Attack COMPUTE locks the miss outcome. Payload: { attackerUuid, defenderUuid, accCheckResult, missMargin: defense - accCheckResult, isMelee, isRanged }. Lives in the post-resolve phase of director-triggers.
Fire after the Guard action resolves. Payload: { guarderUuid, didCoverAlly: bool, coveredAllyUuid }. Hawkeye's gate is `!didCoverAlly`.
Roll a named die (MIGHT/INSIGHT/WILLPOWER/DEXTERITY) and stash result on ctx. Downstream rows reference via `MIGHT_DIE_ROLLED` formula identifier.

engine_gaps_surfaced.gap: Status immunity flag at actor scope
engine_gaps_surfaced._design: Actor-level `status_immune_<name>: bool` props. Gate at apply_ae write time: if the AE being applied carries one of those status slugs AND the bearer's immunity flag is set, skip the AE entirely.
Cost-modifier callback in cost-substitution pipeline. Reduces declared IP cost by 1 (min 1) when actor has Deep Pockets. Parallel to substitute_cost effect_kind.
Phase H scope — plug-in resource framework. Adoration Clock specifically: per-actor track with fill/clear ops + threshold-gated abilities.
Extend CSB AEF's `aeStatusWhen()` to recognize 'crisis' as a derived actor state (HP <= max_hp/2). Then GUP's bonus_defense change becomes `aeStatusWhen('crisis') ? ${level}$ : 0`.
